# Load the data

print(df.head())

print('\nData types:')
print(df.dtypes)

print('\nMissing values:')
print(df.isnull().sum())

print('\nUnique values in customer_age:')
print(df['customer_age'].unique())

# Check for sentinel value -1
print('\nCount of -1 in customer_age:')
print((df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())"}
